summary: This short housekeeping document declares RFC 4693 historic and obsoletes it. It was published for information, not as a standards-track specification, so that readers stop treating the older document as current guidance.

eli5.summary: Imagine a library putting an old, out-of-date book in a case marked "for history only" so nobody uses it by mistake. This note does that for one old RFC.

questions: how to move an rfc to historic
